messages:
sara: Quick sync — planning a production deploy tonight at 23:30 PT for v2.14.3. No schema changes, mostly runtime tweaks. Need smoke owners, rollback plan, and a quick checklist. Who's available?

kai: I can own the smoke run and basic perf checks. Will be online from 23:15.

oliver: I'll be on DB standby — even though no migrations, I'll watch replica lag and connection pools during rollout.

marta: I'll do canary validation on route /generate and run the prompt set (small sample). Ping me when canary finishes.

phil: I'll prepare the rollback playbook and the helm diff + image tag. Also will stage the immediate revert job.

sara: Awesome — summary: kai(smoke), marta(canary), oliver(db), phil(rollback). @deploy-bot can you create the deploy window and add the owners?

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window created: 2026-03-17T23:30:00-07:00. Channel: #eng-releases. Owners: kai, marta, oliver, phil. :white_check_mark:

kai: Checklist I'm planning to run (short):
- [ ] pre-deploy alerts paused? (ops)
- [ ] run smoke script on canary hosts
- [ ] validate latency P50/P95
- [ ] check error-rate <= baseline + 0.5%

marta: My canary steps:
1) Verify traffic routed to canary (10%): `routeset update canary=10`
2) Run prompt fuzz: `./tools/canary_test --samples 50`
3) Check outputs against golden set (quick sanity)

oliver: DB checklist:
- [ ] monitor replica lag < 5s
- [ ] connection pool healthy
- [ ] slow query spike alert on

phil: Rollback plan (TL;DR):
- Revert image tag to `v2.14.2` via helm rollback (1 cmd).
- If canary fails, scale canary down and abort canary->prod promotion.
- If prod shows regression, run `helm rollback release 1` + restart workers.

sara: Communication plan:
- 23:15 all owners in thread check-in
- 23:25 final go/no-go reactions in thread (react with :thumbsup: to proceed)
- 23:30 kick, monitor first 10m closely, escalate to #incidents if >threshold

kai: I'll post smoke results as snippets. If latency or errors spike, I'll mark NO-GO and tag @sara.

marta: Agree. I'll attach canary test logs and a short pass/fail note.

phil: Hotline phone numbers in runbook updated. I'll be reachable via mobile and PagerDuty.

sara: Anything else? If not, I'll lock the window and we do a final preflight at 23:15. Thanks! :rocket:
